evidence.t: Road: Solomon Lake FSR, 5.6 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
20 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from Soda Creek, about 42 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Soda Creek Townsite Rd, Williams Lake Cut-Off Rd, Hwy 97, Mountain House Rd.
Park: 52.33778, -121.82134, where the truck road ends (Solomon Lake FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 190 m to the start. Ride: the Solomon Lake FSR stretch, 5.6 km one way. About 111 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-2, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-07, closures 2026-10-16.
R5D-grouse-atv-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 5-2: about 48,078 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 3.43 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 9 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
